legos.why: The LEGO says 'sir' in English with no 'señor' in Spanish, and so do seven of its rows. K32 (a formal LEGO keeps sir/madam on both sides; in its phrases sir/madam is always added back at the end). The seed is '¿Quiere usted, señor?': the LEGO takes 'señor', and every row ends in 'señor' as its English already ends in 'sir'. (The sister course drops 'sir' instead; the canon rule is to keep it.) The checker's 'does not contain the LEGO' on these rows is that rule at work.
